admission.goal: The client fuzzer accepts a non-empty input buffer and writes it into the SSL input BIO for handshake processing.

root.goal: While parsing a DHE ServerKeyExchange, the client has already assigned `dh` into `peer_tmp` and then reaches error cleanup with `peer_tmp` still aliasing that same `DH` object.
root.predicate: assigned.hit && cleanup.hit && assigned.dh == assigned.peer_dh && cleanup.dh == assigned.dh && cleanup.peer_tmp == assigned.peer_tmp && cleanup.peer_dh == assigned.dh && cleanup.time > assigned.time

target.goal: The later EVP_PKEY destructor frees the same DH object again through the `peer_tmp` wrapper.
target.predicate: free_again.hit && root.cleanup.hit && free_again.pkey == root.cleanup.peer_tmp && free_again.aliased_dh == root.cleanup.dh && free_again.time > root.cleanup.time
